title: How Fast Does Claude, Acting as a User Space IP Stack, Respond to Pings?
summary: Adam Dunkels experiments with using Claude (Anthropic's AI) to act as a user-space IP stack by communicating over a pseudo-terminal, and measures the latency of ICMP ping responses. The experiment explores whether an LLM can function as a network protocol handler.
problem_solved: Explores whether an AI model can serve as a functional network stack by responding to network protocol operations.
why_valuable: Demonstrates creative applications of LLMs beyond traditional text tasks and provides real-world latency benchmarks for AI-mediated network operations.
